==About==

Right-clicking any Pie with the [[Baking]] Skill learned and selecting "Slice" will divide your Pie into 8x {{i|Slice of Pie}}s. When Slicing Pie there is chance to receive a {{i|Little Jack Horner's Thumbnail}}.
{{Notice|WARNING!| Finding a Little Jack Horner's Thumbnail in your Pie adds a great deal of [[Insanity]].}}
